validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + CLASSIFICATION: real, and correctly distinguished from its GEM neighbors. The sheet's own DNR Minstroy Order No. 58-od (27 Mar 2025, archive.org/details/58_20251012) is a primary occupation-administration planning decree that approves siting documentation for 'капитальный ремонт магистрального газопровода Таганрог-Мариуполь [1-я нитка] Ду700 на участке 29,0-71,625 км методом замены трубы' (capital repair / pipe-replacement of the Taganrog-Mariupol trunk gas pipeline, DN700, on the 29.0-71.625 km stretch) -- this independently confirms PipelineName, route (Taganrog RU -> Mariupol UA), Diameter=700mm, Fuel=Gas, PipelineType=transmission ('магистральный'), and that GEM's own SegmentName 'Reconstructed Segment' is the right characterization (this is a REBUILD of a pre-existing Soviet line, not new-build). Found a second DNR document repeating the identical route/diameter language: DNR Ministry of Property and Land Relations public-easement notice dated 23 June 2025 (mariupol-news.ru/politics/2025/06/23/116808.html, verified) -- but this is the SAME origin bucket as the Minstroy decree (both DNR occupation administration), so per country guidance it counts as ONE source, not two. The second, genuinely independent leg is the sheet's other existing ref, United24 (Ukrainian, 24 Jul 2025 dateline citing a 16 Jul 2024 tweet by the Center for Journalistic Investigations with satellite/drone footage) reporting Russia 'laying two pipelines simultaneously -- one from Taganrog...to...Mariupol, and another continuing to Berdyansk, with Melitopol as the final destination.' CAVEAT: I read the full United24 article and it never actually uses the word 'gas' -- it calls them generically 'pipelines' in the context of a broader Rostov-to-Crimea 'land corridor' (which also covers a parallel railway project). The route match to the DNR decree's gas-pipeline corridor is very tight (identical city sequence, identical construction-year window) so I still count it as a second independent origin for EXISTENCE/STATUS, but it is not itself proof the pipelines shown in that footage are the gas line rather than some other utility/rail corridor -- worth knowing before leaning on it further. DUPLICATE CHECK (against the wider Taganrog family, none of it a false duplicate): P1457 (same PipelineName, same Wiki page, status=retired, Taganrog->Berdyansk, LengthKnownKm=516, Diameter=1000mm) is the ORIGINAL big trunk that this row's SegmentName says is being reconstructed -- correctly kept as a separate retired row, not merged with P7817/P7818. P5989 ('Taganrog-Melitopol-Berdyansk Gas Pipeline', status=operating since 2024, Taganrog->Melitopol, LengthEstimateKm=272.73) is a DIFFERENT, already-completed bypass pipeline that skips Mariupol entirely (built instead of reviving the old Mariupol route, per gem.wiki's own background on that page) -- different endpoints, different length order of magnitude, sourced from TASS/DAN only (one Russian-state origin, correctly not elevated). None of these should be folded into P7817; they are three distinct, correctly-separated entities sharing one Soviet-era corridor. ATTRIBUTION: Owner is blank on the sheet. A 2014 Neftegaz.ru piece describes the ORIGINAL (pre-2009) pipeline as 'belonging to Gazprom' historically, but I found no 2024/2025-dated source naming a current owner/operator for the reconstruction (the Minstroy decree only names the planning-documentation contractor, OOO 'Tsentr kompleksnogo proektirovaniya', which is a design consultancy, not an asset owner). Per country guidance I am not filling Owner with Gazprom off a 12-year-old pre-closure fact for occupied Ukrainian territory -- leaving it blank with this note rather than fabricate a current attribution.

validity.recommendation: Re-derive Length for this segment from a route-specific figure rather than the current straight-line city-to-city estimate; flag LengthEstimateKm=104.50 as likely overstated pending a sourced route length.
validity.researcher_notes: LengthEstimateKm=104.50 / LengthMergedKm=104.50 on the sheet is not sourced (LengthKnownKm is blank) -- it reads as an auto-computed geodesic distance between the Taganrog and Mariupol city points (straight-line Taganrog-Mariupol is ~103-104 km, matching the figure almost exactly). But the only documented physical length I could find for THIS specific local pipe is much shorter: a 22 Oct 2014 Neftegaz.ru article (verified) quotes then-DNR fuel/energy minister A. Granovsky describing 'the 33-kilometer main gas pipeline (MGP) "Taganrog-Mariupol", built in the 1950s and closed in 2009 after the Russia-Ukraine gas conflict,' and separately quotes a 2014 Gazprom liquidation tender for the object 'Магистральный газопровод Таганрог-Мариуполь 1 нитка 20,4-56,7 км' (i.e. km-marker range 20.4-56.7, a 36.3 km stretch). The 2025 DNR Minstroy decree's own repair-section markers (km 29.0-71.625, a 42.6 km stretch) are in the same rough range and clearly NOT measured from a Taganrog-city zero point -- they look like markers along a longer trunk (consistent with the wiki page's own title, 'Rostov-Taganrog-Zhdanov', i.e. a route that may start further away at Rostov, which is what P1457's separate 516 km/1000mm figure may actually represent). Either way, none of the historical/documentary evidence supports a ~104.5 km figure specifically for the Taganrog-Mariupol reconstructed segment; the true figure is more likely in the 33-57 km band. I did not find a single authoritative total-length figure I'd stake a fill on, so I'm flagging this as a concern rather than proposing a replacement number -- someone should look at whether LengthEstimateKm should be suppressed/replaced once a real route source is available (e.g. via a §8 route-creation pass).

fills.researcher_notes: DNR Minstroy Order 58-od (27 Mar 2025) repeatedly refers to the object as a 'магистральный газопровод' (trunk GAS pipeline) at each of its three named stretches, including the Taganrog-Mariupol one on this row.
Same decree describes it as 'магистральный' (trunk/main-line), which is GEM's 'transmission' class, not a gathering/distribution line.

Two independent origins agree on both endpoints: the DNR decree names the route 'Таганрог-Мариуполь' explicitly (Taganrog, Rostov Oblast, Russia -> Mariupol, Donetsk, Ukraine), and Ukrainian outlet United24 independently reports Russia building a pipeline 'from Taganrog, Russia, to the occupied Mariupol.'

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Searched Russian and Ukrainian sources for anything newer than the sheet's 10 Oct 2025 LastUpdated / 27 Mar 2025 decree: tsoua.com (no mention -- this segment is occupied territory, outside TSOU's actual network), DAN/TASS/mytaganrog.com/mariupol local news, and general 2026 Mariupol gas-utility news. Found a DNR Ministry of Property and Land Relations notice dated 23 Jun 2025 seeking a 49-year public easement for the SAME three repair objects named in the March decree (verbatim identical route/diameter language) -- this pushes the most recent dated, project-specific evidence to June 2025 and shows the project was still in a land-acquisition/administrative phase then, not yet complete. No source (Ukrainian, Russian, or trade press) reports this specific segment as finished/commissioned. 2026 Mariupol gas-utility news (Донбассгаз/ЧМНГ) covers routine local distribution maintenance, not this trunk repair. Given no completion evidence and no independent report contradicting 'construction', I confirm the recorded Status. The dormancy/staleness rules (2y->shelved, 4y->cancelled) apply to 'proposed'/'shelved' rows, not 'construction', so they aren't triggered here regardless.

summary: P7817 (Taganrog-Mariupol reconstruction) is real and correctly classified/located/split from its GEM relatives (P1457 retired original, P5989 separate operating bypass) -- confirmed via the sheet's own DNR decree + United24 refs; added missing Fuel/PipelineType/Location refs; flagged LengthEstimateKm=104.50 as an unsourced straight-line estimate likely well above the ~33-57 km documented for this local pipe (concern_type=spec); status review confirms 'construction' (no completion evidence found, freshest dated evidence Jun 2025).
